name: Tilskudd til vannmiljøtiltak, restaureringstiltak Oslofjorden, kalking og anadrome laksefisk
summary: Annual Norwegian grant for water-environment measures, Oslofjord restoration (habitats, eelgrass, marine litter and lost-gear clean-up, riparian vegetation, fish passage), liming and wild anadromous salmonids. Open to municipalities, voluntary organisations, research bodies and private firms.
